title: Impact of PROTAC Linker Plasticity on the Solution Conformations and Dissociation of the Ternary Complex.
authors: Weerakoon, Dhanushka; Carbajo, Rodrigo J; De Maria, Leonardo; Tyrchan, Christian; Zhao, Hongtao
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟研究PROTAC三元复合物的构象与解离，对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: The conformational behavior of a small molecule free in solution is important to understand the free energy of binding to its target. This could be of special interest for proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) due to their often flexible and lengthy linkers and the need to induce a ternary complex. Here, we report on the molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of two PROTACs, MZ1 and dBET6, revealing different linker conformational behaviors. The simulation of MZ1 in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) agrees well with the nuclear magnetic resonance study, providing strong support for the relevance of our simulations. To further understand the role of linker plasticity in the formation of a ternary complex, the dissociation of the complex von Hippel-Lindau-MZ1-BRD4 is investigated in detail by steered simulations and is shown to follow a two-step pathway. Interestingly, both MZ1 and dBET6 display in water, a tendency toward an intramolecular lipophilic interaction between the two warheads. The hydrophobic contact of the two warheads would prevent them from binding to their respective proteins and might have an effect on the efficacy of induced cellular protein degradation. However, conformations featuring this hydrophobic contact of the two warheads are calculated to be marginally more favorable.
abstract_zh: 小分子在溶液中自由状态下的构象行为对于理解其与靶标结合的自由能至关重要。这对于蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTACs）可能特别有意义，因为它们通常具有灵活且较长的连接子，并且需要诱导形成三元复合物。在此，我们报告了两种PROTACs，MZ1和dBET6的分子动力学（MD）模拟，揭示了不同的连接子构象行为。MZ1在二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的模拟与核磁共振研究结果高度一致，为我们的模拟相关性提供了有力支持。为了进一步理解连接子可塑性在三元复合物形成中的作用，我们通过受控模拟详细研究了von Hippel-Lindau-MZ1-BRD4复合物的解离过程，并显示其遵循两步路径。有趣的是，MZ1和dBET6在水中均表现出两个弹头之间分子内亲脂性相互作用的倾向。两个弹头之间的疏水接触会阻止它们与各自蛋白质结合，并可能对诱导细胞蛋白降解的效率产生影响。然而，计算表明，具有这种两个弹头疏水接触的构象仅略微更有利。
